variants.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Drown in Dreams by paying {15}{U} minus {1} for each card in your hand, causing you to draw cards until you have thirteen cards in hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

feature.name: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

variants.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

variants.description:
Donate Moderation to an opponent.
Cast Knowledge Pool by paying {6}.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

feature.name: Exile all spells target opponent casts from their hand
Target opponent can only cast one spell per turn
